name: Viridia
look: a sinuous emerald viper banded in violet, its scales jewel-bright and its eyes amethyst, a thin trace of green venom at its fangs
temperament: Patient, sly and affectionate in a dangerous way; it whispers what it overhears
scenePlacement: coiled around her forearm with its head raised near her shoulder
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
